about: Hand-written development set (26 Nov 2026): short call transcripts as Whisper would write them, labelled scam / benign by the team. It checks the scam-language rules; it is NOT an independent benchmark and is small, so treat the numbers as a sanity check. A call is flagged when its scam score reaches 0.5 (the server's scam_at = 50).

Held-out call set (27 Nov 2026), written as new conversations AFTER the keyword rules and the classifier's training set, and never used to tune either. Indirect scams and hard negatives (genuine delivery OTPs, genuine bank and police calls, genuine family money requests). Team-written: an honest second check, not an independent benchmark. A call is flagged at score >= 0.5.

Blind call set (27 Nov 2026), written BEFORE the intent-frame layer was coded and evaluated once, with no tuning afterwards. Team-written, small; it complements scam_eval.json (rules were designed on it) and scam_eval_heldout.json (its errors were seen before the frame layer was designed).
